Sofia (CS): Quick heads-up — running a rapid feedback sweep with 5 pilot customers next week to validate onboarding flow and flag renewal risks. Need volunteers for notes + follow-ups.
Ravi (PM): Proposed times Mon/Tue 9-11am PT. Can ENG join for infra Qs? @Noah can you take Mon?
Noah (SE): I can do Mon 9:30. Will bring a short troubleshooting checklist and the internal runbook link: https://redwood.ai/internal/onboard.
Leah (Research): For capture, suggest a 6-question micro-survey + 30-min call script. I'll drop the form and rubric here: https://forms.redwood.com/pilot-sweep-2025
Sofia (CS): Owners: Sofia = invites & post-call outreach, Noah = SSO + provisioning triage, Leah = survey + notes export, Ravi = compile deal-risk tags (SSO, data residency, perf).
Noah (SE): Quick config note for Okta: set `provisioning.scim.enabled=true` in the YAML. Also for air-gapped demos include `imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent`.
Ravi (PM): Remind folks to score "activation confidence" 1-5 and mark any "deal-breaker" infra items. Those become P0s in the backlog.
OnboardBot: Event created: Pilot Feedback Sweep — Mon 2025-06-30 09:30 PT. Attendees: Sofia, Ravi, Noah, Leah. Meet link: https://meet.redwood.com/pilot-sweep-abc
Sofia (CS): Post-call plan: send Loom + micro-survey within 24h, compile top 3 frictions and assign quick-win owners. I'll DM the roster now.
Leah (Research): I'll tag quotes and export CSV; will highlight recurring friction patterns.
Noah (SE): I'll prep a one-pager "Known workarounds" and share before the call.
Sofia (CS): Thanks — dropping a short checklist in 20m for what I need from each owner. Ping me if you want to join live. :party_popper:
